facts.fact: Financial Afrik reports Sonatel inaugurated its Dakar data centre on 20 June 2017 (2,224 m2 building, three 250 m2 server rooms), letting companies and administrations outsource their servers.
Financial Afrik states Sonatel's Dakar data centre is Tier 3+ (a stated rating, no certifier named).
